name: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc.
moat_justification: Real qualification switching costs in plasma power for leading-edge fabs (eVerest/eVoS design wins validated on yield/throughput) and in hyperscaler rack power, against through-cycle ROIC that collapsed in the trough (roic_proxy 19.9% in FY2022, 8.8% FY2023, 2.8% FY2024, 13.1% FY2025) and gross margin of 35.7-37.7% over the last five fiscal years (39.3% TTM) — well below the 50%+ of 2016-18 after mix shift and acquisitions. A genuine technology position, but cyclical, customer-concentrated and re-qualified program by program; not a durable wide moat.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

IRR_AT_FLOOR: implied IRR sits within 0.5pp of terminal growth 2.5% (super_bear) — a perpetuity growing at g has an IRR above g at any price, so the model cannot express a return below ~2.5%; this price is beyond the model's range and the expected return is 'at most ~3.0%', not the recorded figure
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.8% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 8.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 3.2x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict
one_liner: Good cyclical precision-power franchise, moat 5/10, in a genuine AI semi/data-center upcycle — but at $238.05 the price capitalizes far more than owner's earnings can deliver: weighted IRR 4.1%, IV@15% $26.25, and it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$26; even the super-bull IV@15% ($69.05) is less than a third of the price.
moat_for: Leading plasma power position (eVerest/eVoS) with customer-validated yield/throughput gains at leading-edge logic and memory nodes — high qualification switching costs in fab tools
Design wins in hyperscaler data-center rack power, incl. next-generation and 800V programs, plus second-wave customers ramping 2027
Broad precision-power portfolio across semiconductor, data center, industrial and medical with global engineering and manufacturing scale
Net cash balance sheet (net debt -$223.7M) funds the Thailand/Malaysia/Philippines/Mexico capacity build without leverage
moat_against: Through-cycle ROIC is mediocre and volatile: roic_proxy 19.1%/19.9% (FY2021/22) fell to 8.8%/2.8% (FY2023/24) before recovering to 13.1% (FY2025)
Gross margin 35.7-37.7% over the last five fiscal years — structurally below the 50%+ earned in 2016-18; recovery to ~42% is guided, not yet delivered
Deep cyclicality: revenue fell -10.3% in FY2023 and -10.5% in FY2024; OE/share fell from $3.09 (FY2023) to $0.74 (FY2024)
Customer and end-market concentration: semiconductor capex and a handful of hyperscalers set demand; competition from MKS and other power specialists is program-by-program
Growth now requires heavy capex: 2026 guided capex $180-195M vs D&A of ~$62M, so owner's earnings lag reported earnings through the build
